method: Visual inspection of the published chart image (data/digitized/ramesh-2013/figure4-hr-co.jpg); NOT pixel-calibrated digitization. Two side-by-side simple bar charts (CO panel, HR panel), both with clearly gridded but TRUNCATED y-axes -- CO axis runs 5-10 ppm, HR axis runs 58-74 bpm, NOT starting at zero. This must be preserved in any rendering (a naive zero-baselined bar chart would visually exaggerate the effect relative to the source).
confidence: moderate-high -- bars are cleanly separated and axes are gridded, but exact pixel-level precision is not claimed. Treat each value as +/- 0.1-0.2 ppm (CO) or +/- 0.3-0.5 bpm (HR).
cross_check: Significance markers read off the chart are consistent with the exact text-reported directional comparisons (ramesh-2013-hr-dose, ramesh-2013-co-dose): HR increases at all active conditions (0<2 *, and 4/6 ***), CO decreases significantly at 4 (**) and 6 (***) puffs vs 0.
